## Subsystem

<!-- Pick one. Mirrors the labels in MAINTAINERS.md. -->

- [ ] `proofs/` (kernel theorem)
- [ ] `proofs-mathlib/` (mathlib extension)
- [ ] `core/` (Rust implementation)
- [ ] `services/` (Python / API / ML)
- [ ] `integrations/` (adapter, EVM, Fabric)
- [ ] `spec/` (normative change)
- [ ] `paper/` (new claim / section)
- [ ] Cross-cutting / governance / docs

<!-- What problem does this solve? Who benefits? Cite a paper

<!-- A sketch is fine. Reference the existing types / theorems /

## Alternatives considered

<!-- "Just use X" is a valid alternative if X works. Tell us why

## Open questions

## Is this on the roadmap?

Check [`docs/PLAN.md`](../../docs/PLAN.md) and
[`ROADMAP.md`](../../ROADMAP.md). If your proposal aligns with an
open phase (C+3a, C+3b, C+ heavy mathlib, E++, G, …), call that out
so the maintainer can route it.
